evidence.velocity_vs_rigour: Work in small teams of exceptional people, who are relentlessly resourceful to solve problems and find smarter solutions than the status quo
evidence.velocity_vs_rigour_explanation: The JD emphasizes ownership, speed, and resourcefulness ("No two days look the same", "relentlessly resourceful") with no testing/governance/data-quality language present, so velocity.
evidence.domain_risk: we're going after the two biggest Western markets (UK and US) where trillions worth of financial products are held by big banks
evidence.domain_risk_explanation: Lendable is a fintech/consumer credit company (loans, credit cards, car finance) — a default-high-risk sector — and no generic language overrides that classification.
evidence.data_team_maturity: You'll work with a modern data stack centred around Snowflake, dbt and Python.
evidence.data_team_maturity_explanation: Named tools already form the current production stack (Snowflake, dbt, Python) with an existing Python Infrastructure team, indicating a mid-maturity function that is still actively growing.
evidence.jd_authorship: You'll work on transforming and modelling data using SQL and dbt, while also leveraging Python to build data workflows, automate processes, and build tools to optimise day to day work.
evidence.jd_authorship_explanation: Named tools with precise application context (SQL, dbt, Python, Snowflake) make the day-to-day work concrete, so hiring_manager.
evidence.stakeholder_orientation: You'd love for you to become a key part of our Python Infrastructure team
evidence.stakeholder_orientation_explanation: The role sits within a Python Infrastructure/data engineering team building internal data workflows and tooling, with no specific external business function named as the primary audience, so internal_data.
evidence.autonomy_level: Take ownership across a broad remit. You are trusted to make decisions that drive a material impact on the direction and success of Lendable from day 1
evidence.autonomy_level_explanation: The role combines strategic ownership language ("trusted to make decisions") with execution-level tasks (transforming data, building pipelines), so mixed.
evidence.ai_role_explanation: AI is mentioned only generically in company mission language ("using new data sources, machine learning and AI") with no specific AI skill or tool expected of the candidate.
evidence.testing_framing: No testing or data quality signal anywhere in the JD.
evidence.testing_framing_explanation: No mention of data testing, quality frameworks, or data contracts appears anywhere in the responsibilities or requirements.
evidence.loss_aversion_framing_explanation: The JD is framed entirely in ownership, speed, and building terms with no risk, compliance, or trust register present despite being a fintech company.
evidence.greenfield_vs_fix: Build the best technology in-house, using new data sources, machine learning and AI to make machines do the heavy lifting
evidence.greenfield_vs_fix_explanation: The role mixes new tool/workflow building with maintaining existing data pipelines and ETL processes, so mixed.
evidence.work_arrangement: Hybrid roles require three days in-office weekly; fully remote roles include regular opportunities for in-person connection through socials and off-sites
